# ANALYSIS: hybrid-shell-foundation

- **Project:** know-meet
- **Date:** 2026-11-09
- **Mode:** stack specified, by `goals.md`: React 19, Tauri, Flutter, shadcn/ui, clean architecture. No stack discovery was run, so there is no `stack-recommendation.md`.
- **Inputs:**
  - `assessment.md` (adversarial review PASS, round 2)
  - `prior-context.md`
  - The read-only survey of `/Users/gqadonis/Projects/hybrid-mobile-architecture-src`
- **Budget:** 8 queries per tier and 20 minutes. Used: tier 1: 5, tier 2: 6, tier 3: 1 batch covering 11 packages, tier 4: 0. Time used was about 12 minutes, under the cap, so confidence was not lowered for budget reasons.

## Recalled lessons and knowledge gaps

- **Applicable lesson:** the knowme-builder package "also supplies skills worth binding: design tokens, UI fidelity, Flutter goldens, accessibility gate, sync doctrine and dependency pinning." Each of those skills appears below as an adopt or reference candidate, not just the generator.
- **Knowledge gaps:** none recorded in `prior-context.md`.

## Landscape summary

1. **Shared web and desktop workspace.** GitHub shows only small, low-star Tauri monorepo templates (`Stormix/vite-tauri-monorepo` 5★, last updated 2024; `rviso/tauri-monorepo-template` 3★, Vue). None is a credible base. Tauri itself supports the pattern natively: `build.frontendDist`, `devUrl`, `beforeDevCommand` and `beforeBuildCommand` accept any path and command (Tauri v2 docs, `start/frontend/vite.mdx`). So `src-tauri` can build and serve a React app that lives in another workspace package. This is a **pattern to adopt, not a dependency**.
2. **Token pipeline.** The package's `gen-design-tokens.mjs` cannot accept Know Meet's values: it is hex-only, uses TOML, hardcodes its fonts, and writes neither web, shadcn nor `ThemeData` output (see the assessment). Style Dictionary 5.8.0 (Apache-2.0, released 2026-11-03) accepts DTCG/JSON sources and has a built-in `css/variables` format and a built-in `flutter/class.dart` format, plus custom formats and transform groups (Context7 `/style-dictionary/style-dictionary`).
3. **UI kit.**
   - **Web:** shadcn CLI 4.23.0 with Tailwind 4.3.5 (both MIT, current). Components are copied into the repo as source, so they can be renamed to kebab-case and themed through CSS variables.
   - **Flutter:** `forui` 0.27.7 (2026-10-26) and `shadcn_flutter` 0.0.55 (2026-10-01) both require Flutter ≥ 3.47. `shadcn_flutter` is still on a 0.0.x line, and the package's own lessons record a stale or invented pin for it.
4. **Rule enforcement.**
   - **Naming:** `@ls-lint/ls-lint` 2.3.2 (MIT) supports per-directory, per-extension rules, `.dir` rules, globs and ignore lists. That covers kebab-case everywhere plus `snake_case` for `.dart` and `.rs`, and the E-N exception list.
   - **Line counts:** no cross-language line-count checker turned up within the budget. `eslint` `max-lines` covers JS and TS only.
5. **Fidelity verification.**
   - **Web:** `@playwright/test` 1.65.0 (`toHaveScreenshot`) can capture both the prototype pages and the shells at fixed viewports and themes.
   - **Flutter:** `alchemist` 0.14.1 handles golden tests, and the package's `flutter-golden-ui` skill wraps the practice.
   - **Tauri webview:** screenshots are not covered by any candidate checked. The package's `tauri-ui-review` skill is a manual or agent screenshot procedure. Proving the bundle is the same build (VS-2) can instead rest on the web build's artifact hash plus Tauri's `frontendDist` pointing at that artifact.

## Build-vs-adopt decisions

| Gap | Decision | Candidate | Readiness effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| Generator (Goal 1) | **adapt** | cand-001 knowme-builder | `scenarioMatrix` and `functionalScope`. READY only after the operator approves the restructuring budget (Q-A1) |
| Shared web → Tauri (Goal 2) | **adopt pattern** | cand-002 Tauri `frontendDist` and `before*Command` | Satisfies VS-2 with no new runtime code beyond the workspace layout |
| Workspace tooling (Goal 8) | **adopt** | cand-003 pnpm workspace (pinned 11.15.0 in `versions.toml`) | Defines build, test and lint commands |
| Token pipeline (Goals 5, 7) | **adopt**, with the generator's pipeline as reference | cand-004 Style Dictionary, cand-005 `gen-design-tokens.mjs` | Requires reconciling the token source first (assessment Q0) |
| Web UI kit (Goal 5) | **adopt** | cand-006 shadcn, cand-007 Tailwind 4 | Components live as source in a shared `ui` package, kebab-case |
| Flutter UI kit (Goals 3, 7) | **adapt** forui; **reference** `shadcn_flutter` | cand-008, cand-009 | Contested at library level (see Q-A4) |
| Naming rule | **adopt** | cand-010 ls-lint | Blocking constraint `kebab-case-file-names` becomes checkable |
| 500-line rule | **build** (small script) | — (`build_required`) | Blocking constraint `max-500-lines-per-file` becomes checkable |
| Web fidelity oracle (VS-1, VS-7) | **adopt** | cand-011 Playwright | Screenshot baseline from the prototype pages |
| Flutter fidelity (VS-3) | **adopt** | cand-012 alchemist, plus the `flutter-golden-ui` skill | — |
| Package process skills | **adopt** | cand-013 the package's sibling skills | Bound into Plan roles |

### cand-001 knowme-builder: adapt

- **Fit.** It produces the Tauri `src-tauri` baseline (with `build.rs`, capabilities, icons and `vite-env.d.ts` fixed at source) and the Flutter shell. It does not produce a shared web package.
- **Proposed procedure** (option (a) from the assessment, now recommended):
  1. Reinstall the builder at alpha.5 and align the pins.
  2. Generate `sovereign-hybrid` and `governed-web-shell` into a **scratch directory**, never the repo root.
  3. Move only the shell surfaces into the target layout below.
- **Keep, strip or stub** (assessment item 3a):

  | Surface | Recommendation | Reason |
  |---|---|---|
  | Tauri `src-tauri` | **Keep** | Desktop host |
  | Flutter app | **Keep** | Mobile host |
  | React notes feature | **Keep as reference only** | Replaced by the Know Meet shell |
  | `rust/gen_ui_*` crates and flutter_rust_bridge | **Strip** this phase | No Rust domain logic is in scope |
  | Axum BFF and service UAR | **Strip** | Server, auth and agents are excluded |
  | PEM / entity-graph dependencies | **Strip** | No data or persistence is in scope |

  Stripping Rust core diverges from SKILL.md Step 3 rule 1 ("all networking … agent logic lives in Rust"). That rule governs *where* such logic goes. A shell phase that has none of that logic doesn't violate it, but the operator must accept the deferral explicitly (Q-A1).
- **Why not option (b) or (c).**
  - (b), an upstream profile, needs writes to the read-only reference repo, so it would need a separate phase there.
  - (c), merging two generated trees, duplicates the web app, which defeats Goal 2.

### Target layout (input to Spec)

```text
apps/
  web/           # Vite entry → builds packages/app-shell for the browser
  desktop/       # src-tauri only; frontendDist → apps/web/dist (one bundle, VS-2)
  mobile/        # Flutter (lower_snake_case Dart files, E-N1)
packages/
  app-shell/     # React 19 shell: features/<feature>/{domain,application,infrastructure,presentation}
  ui/            # shadcn components (kebab-case), themed by tokens
  design-tokens/ # Style Dictionary source + outputs (CSS vars, Tailwind @theme, Dart)
tools/
  repo-rules/    # line-count checker + ls-lint config wiring
```

Layer mapping for generator code moved into `packages/app-shell` (assessment item 7):

| Generator layer | Mandated layer |
|---|---|
| `entities` | domain |
| `stores`, `hooks`, `app/` | application |
| `api`, `data`, Tauri IPC adapters | infrastructure, behind `isTauri()` guards |
| `components`, screens | presentation |

### cand-004 / cand-005 token pipeline

- **Adopt Style Dictionary** with one DTCG JSON source in `packages/design-tokens`, built from the reconciled `tokens.json` plus `km.css` (assessment Q0). It emits:
  - `css/variables` for both themes, including shadcn's variable names (`--background`, `--primary` and so on), mapped from Know Meet roles
  - A Tailwind 4 `@theme` file (a custom format)
  - `flutter/class.dart` constants, plus a custom format that emits a `ThemeData` builder
- **Keep the package's pipeline as reference.** Its WCAG 2.2 AA rule for both themes and its role names carry over to `hybrid-design-tokens`. It cannot express the rgba values or `clamp()` sizes, so it isn't adopted.
- **Flutter cannot express `clamp()`.** The Dart output takes the maximum and minimum and resolves sizes by breakpoint. That is a design decision to record in Spec.

## Contested choices and open questions

None is contested at the stack level, because the stack is specified. The questions below need the operator before or during Spec. Each has a recommended default.

- **Q-A1 Generator restructuring budget.** Is option (a) accepted, with Rust core, Axum, UAR and PEM stripped this phase and Tauri and Flutter kept from the generator? *Recommended: yes.* Without this, Goal 1 has no testable meaning.
- **Q-A2 Token source of truth.** Use `km.css` as the canonical values, migrated into a DTCG source owned by Style Dictionary, so `tokens.json` and `tokens.css` become outputs. *Recommended.* The alternative is to reconcile into `tokens.json` and keep it hand-edited.
- **Q-A3 In-scope routes (VS-7).** *Recommended:* the app frame (header, navigation, theme toggle) plus the static screens of `index`, `auth`, `join`, `dashboard`, `agents`, `recordings` and `settings`, and the `meet` room layout with media stubbed. Exclude interactive flows.
- **Q-A4 Flutter UI kit.** *Recommended: forui* (0.27 line, more releases), with Know Meet theming. Alternatively build plain Material 3 widgets themed from tokens. `shadcn_flutter` (0.0.x) stays reference-only.
- **Q-A5 Toolchain pins.** Choose between the package pins (`versions.toml`: tauri-cli 2.11.4, Flutter 3.47.5 stable) and the current upstream releases (tauri-cli and `@tauri-apps/api` 2.12.4). *Recommended:* follow `versions.toml` for this phase, because the generator was verified against it. Record the drift as a known item.
- **Q-A6 Exceptions E-L6 and E-L7** (carried over from the assessment).
- **Q-A7 Parallel agent-team session.** Confirm it has stopped (carried over).

## Build required

- **Cross-language line-count checker.** Implement it as a small Node script in `tools/repo-rules/`, honouring the E-L exception globs. It runs in lint, pre-commit and CI. No maintained tool covers every language within the budget; `eslint` `max-lines` is JS/TS only.
- **Style Dictionary custom formats** for:
  - shadcn CSS variable names
  - the Tailwind 4 `@theme` block
  - the Flutter `ThemeData` builder
- **Fidelity harness.** A Playwright spec that captures the prototype route screenshots (dark and light; 375, 768, 1024 and 1440) as the baseline, and the same routes from `apps/web`.

## Readiness recommendation

**BLOCKED, minimal:** Spec can be written once Q-A1, Q-A2 and Q-A3 are answered. They set the contract's functional scope, the token source and the scenario matrix. Q-A4 to Q-A7 can be resolved during Spec with the recommended defaults. No new runtime code is needed to reach READY to spec; only operator decisions are.

# Know Meet — KBD Constraints

Project-specific rules for KBD verification. Derived from the generic KBD
template plus Know Meet conventions. The repository has no `AGENTS.md` yet, so
there is no "Never Do" section to import. Revisit this file when the hybrid
shell workspace adds one.

Build, test and lint commands are not defined yet (see `project.json`). Until
the hybrid shell phase sets them, `build-passes` and `no-lint-warnings` are
checked against the commands that phase introduces.

---

## Blocking constraints

```yaml
constraints:
  - id: no-livekit-secrets-in-repo
    severity: blocking
    description: 'LIVEKIT_API_SECRET / LIVEKIT_API_KEY values never appear in tracked files; they come from the shell environment only'
    check: "git grep --untracked -nE 'LIVEKIT_API_SECRET\\s*[:=]\\s*[\"\\x27]?[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}' -- . ':!*.md'"

  - id: no-hardcoded-secrets
    severity: blocking
    description: 'No hardcoded API keys, tokens or passwords in source'
    check: "git grep --untracked -nE '(sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|api_key\\s*=\\s*[\"\\x27][A-Za-z0-9]{12,})' -- apps packages docs/design/live"

  - id: token-secret-stays-server-side
    severity: blocking
    description: 'Browser, Tauri webview and Flutter client code never receive the LiveKit API secret; tokens are minted server-side'
    note: 'Manual review of any token / auth change'

  - id: design-tokens-single-source
    severity: blocking
    description: 'Brand colors, type and spacing come from the Know Meet design tokens (docs/design/tokens.css / tokens.json); no ad-hoc hex values in app UI code'
    note: 'Applies to React, Tauri and Flutter themes; Flutter theme must be generated from or mirror tokens.json'

  - id: reference-repo-read-only
    severity: blocking
    description: '/Users/gqadonis/Projects/hybrid-mobile-architecture-src is a read-only reference; never write to it from this project'

  - id: max-500-lines-per-file
    severity: blocking
    description: 'No authored file exceeds 500 lines in any language; oversized files become a feature directory split by clean-architecture layer (see AGENTS.md)'
    exceptions: 'lockfiles; generated code (*.g.dart, *.freezed.dart, routeTree.gen.ts, frb output, src-tauri/gen/**); vendored code (**/vendor/**); native platform project files; test fixtures/goldens; tool-generated AI-harness skill/command files under .agents|.claude|.codex|.dsh|.kimi-code|.opencode|.qwen|.zed; docs/design/** and long-form docs pending operator decision (E-L6, E-L7)'
    note: 'Checker script to be added to lint, pre-commit and CI in this phase'

  - id: kebab-case-file-names
    severity: blocking
    description: 'File and directory names are kebab-case'
    exceptions: 'Dart *.dart lower_snake_case; Rust module files snake_case; tool-mandated names (README.md, LICENSE, CHANGELOG.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Cargo.toml, build.rs, main.rs, lib.rs, mod.rs, pubspec.yaml, package.json, tsconfig*.json, vite.config.ts, components.json, tauri.conf.json, Dockerfile, dotfiles); native platform scaffolding; generator-owned names; tool-generated AI-harness files (SKILL.md, command files, .openspec-target) under harness dot-directories'

  - id: no-any-type
    severity: blocking
    description: 'No `any` type in TypeScript source'
    check: "git grep -nE ':\\s*any\\b' -- '*.ts' '*.tsx'"

  - id: build-passes
    severity: blocking
    description: 'Project build must pass without errors'
    command: '<see .kbd-orchestrator/project.json build_health_command>'
```

---

## Warning constraints

```yaml
  - id: design-prototype-fidelity
    severity: warning
    description: 'Shell UI matches the reference prototype (docs/design/prototype, docs/design/live) in look, feel and both themes'
    note: 'Visual comparison at 375 / 768 / 1024 / 1440 in light and dark'

  - id: shadcn-components-not-forked-ad-hoc
    severity: warning
    description: 'UI primitives come from the shared shadcn/ui component set themed with Know Meet tokens, not one-off copies per app'

  - id: clean-architecture-boundaries
    severity: warning
    description: 'Domain and application layers do not import UI, Tauri, Flutter or LiveKit SDK code; adapters live at the edge'

  - id: no-console-log-in-commits
    severity: warning
    description: 'No console.log in committed TypeScript/JavaScript application code'
    check: "git grep -n 'console\\.log' -- '*.ts' '*.tsx'"

  - id: tests-for-new-features
    severity: warning
    description: 'Tests exist for new features added in a change'

  - id: no-stub-comments
    severity: warning
    description: 'No TODO/FIXME/STUB/HACK comments in committed code'

  - id: accessibility-basics
    severity: warning
    description: 'New UI has semantic HTML or accessible names, visible focus, and reduced-motion support'
```

## Path ownership

- `docs/design/prototype/` and `docs/design/live/` are design references. Shell
  work reads them; changes there are design changes, not shell changes.
- `live/` at the repo root is a stale duplicate of `docs/design/live/`. It is
  pending removal and must not be used as a source.
